title: North and South Pontotoc move into separate basketball regions in 2027
excerpt: New Albany stays on North Pontotoc’s region slate. South Pontotoc draws four new opponents, while Pontotoc High keeps all five of its current region opponents.
locality: Pontotoc, North Pontotoc and South Pontotoc high schools in Pontotoc County, Mississippi.

facts.statement: This winter is the last in the current cycle that North Pontotoc and South Pontotoc will face each other as region opponents in basketball. The Mississippi High School Activities Association has placed them in separate Class 4A regions for the 2027–28 and 2028–29 seasons. They currently share Region 1 with Corinth, New Albany and Tishomingo County.
facts.evidence: The two MHSAA basketball tables show both schools under 4A Region 1 in 2025–27 and under separate headings in 2027–29.
facts.date_context: Basketball region assignments for 2025–27 compared with the 2027–29 cycle released November 4, 2026.

facts.identities: Mississippi High School Activities Association and the three Pontotoc County-area high schools.

facts.statement: North Pontotoc will move to Region 2. New Albany makes the move with North, while Byhalia, Clarksdale and Senatobia round out the five-team group. New Albany is the only one of North’s current region opponents that will stay on its region schedule.
facts.evidence: The 4A Region 2 listing names these five schools. Only New Albany and North appear together in both cycles.

paragraphs.text: This winter is the last in the current cycle that North Pontotoc and South Pontotoc will face each other as region opponents in basketball. The Mississippi High School Activities Association has placed them in separate Class 4A regions for the 2027–28 and 2028–29 seasons. They currently share Region 1 with Corinth, New Albany and Tishomingo County.

North Pontotoc will move to Region 2. New Albany makes the move with North, while Byhalia, Clarksdale and Senatobia round out the five-team group. New Albany is the only one of North’s current region opponents that will stay on its region schedule.
South Pontotoc will play in Region 4 with Amory, Houston, Louisville and Shannon. All four will be new region opponents for South.

Pontotoc High’s region schedule will look more familiar. The Warriors remain in Class 5A Region 1 with Caledonia, Columbus, Lafayette, New Hope and West Point, the same five opponents listed for the current cycle.
